description: Retained record of the PM132 live service journey on the original Lecture 14 slide (November 1, 2026, 08:02 UTC): Muse Spark read the slide and Muse Wonder checked the reading and reviewed the words; the learner cut D–F with no model call; Muse chose the connection for the tipping point and Soma computed it; a follow-up kept the experiment; the saved exploration reopened exactly. Model output and Soma computation only; no image, credentials or learner data. Scope: a real-provider service run, not the hosted UI and not held-out evidence. The Wonder review that sent one step back is in wonder-review.json beside this file.
